pages.text: The following glyphs affect the spell’s core functioning, and are directly related to the cursorium’s execution. They are useful for gating and delaying the cursorium so glyphs run precisely when casters need them to.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.wait_input
pages.text: →$(br)Pauses the spell until an input is pushed onto the capsum. Useful for gating effects until after projectiles impact a target.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.wait_ticks
pages.text: $(n)number$() →$(br)Pauses the spell for the ticks specified by the provided number.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.stop
pages.text: →$(br)Stops a spell from executing any glyphs on the cursorium after this one.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.expect_pos
pages.text: $(n)result$() → $(n)vector$()$(br)Reads a result expecting a vector. If found, returns the vector contained in the result, otherwise ends the spell’s execution.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.expect_entity
pages.text: $(n)result$() → $(n)entity$()$(br)Reads a result expecting an entity. If found, returns the entity contained in the result, otherwise ends the spell’s execution.

pages.title: glyph.lingua_mundi.get_computation
pages.text: → $(n)number$()$(br)Pushes onto the capsum a number corresponding to the remaining computation capacity of a casting item (computation for this glyph already deducted).
